study type: Descriptive study/Retrospective review of prescribing practices
cohort: The participants were patients who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary hospital in Toronto, Ontario.
finding: The study found high variance in VTE risk stratification from national regulatory organizations and inconsistencies in VTE prophylaxis prescribing practices after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study specifically examined VTE prophylaxis prescribing and risk stratification in patients after cesarean delivery, highlighting variance directly within this mode of birth.
